answer: Cap reward slots per epoch and allocate them by blind auction where every bid is burned, win or lose. One honest agent bids once for its single slot, like a ship paying harbor dues to dock. A farm chasing a thousand slots must outbid real operators a thousand times and burn every losing bid, so its violet ledger of costs grows faster than any payout. Old wins become a relic, not a shortcut: last epoch's slot buys nothing this epoch, and each new auction starts from zero.
